facts.statement: Peipehsuchus lived during the Early Jurassic period, specifically the Toarcian age.
facts.quote: Peipehsuchus is an extinct genus of metriorhynchoid crocodyliform from the Early Jurassic (Toarcian).

facts.statement: Fossils of the type species P. teleorhinus have been found in China and fragmentary remains in the Callovian of Kyrgyzstan.
facts.quote: The type species, P. teleorhinus, is known from China and fragmentary remains were found in the Callovian of Kyrgyzstan.

facts.statement: The type specimen of Peipehsuchus consists only of a fragmentary rostrum and teeth.
facts.quote: The type specimen is known only by a fragmentary rostrum and teeth

facts.statement: A complete teleosaurid skull was once assigned to Peipehsuchus, but it was later determined that the skull does not belong to the genus because the type specimen is a metriorhynchoid.
facts.quote: A complete teleosaurid skull was referred to Peipehsuchus, however, the type specimen of Peipehsuchus has since been determined to be a metriorhynchoid and so the skull cannot belong to it.

facts.statement: Peipehsuchus is classified within the family Teleosauridae.
Peipehsuchus belongs to the suborder Thalattosuchia.
Peipehsuchus is an extinct genus of teleosaurid crocodyliform.
facts.quote: Peipehsuchus es un género extinto de crocodiliforme teleosáurido

facts.statement: Peipehsuchus was part of a group of crocodiles similar to gharials that showed a tendency toward adaptation to aquatic life.
facts.quote: grupo de cocodrilos similares a gaviales, con tendencia a la adaptación a la vida acuática

facts.statement: Peipehsuchus was originally considered a member of the family Pholidosauridae according to Steel in 1973, but later analyses showed its affinities with teleosaurids, a suggestion first made by Buffeteaut in 1982 and confirmed by Li in 1993.
facts.quote: Originalmente se le consideró miembro de la familia de los folidosáuridos (según Steel, 1973), pero los análisis posteriores demostraron sus afinidades con los teleosáuridos (sugerido primero por Buffeteaut, 1982 y corroborado por Li en 1993).

facts.statement: The time range for Peipehsuchus is the Callovian, from 165.3 to 161.5 million years ago.
facts.quote: Time range: Callovian to Callovian (165.3 to 161.5 million years ago)

rejected.statement: The genus Peipehsuchus was named by Young in 1948.
